scripts.//deploy: wrangler is run via `pnpm dlx`, not depended on. It drags ~500 lines into pnpm-lock.yaml, which SEAMS.md records as the second-worst rebase-conflict surface in this fork — and it is only ever needed at deploy time, on CI, where a one-shot fetch costs nothing.
scripts.//deploy:legacy: Redeploys the pre-#71 t3x-update-relay hostname as a pass-through to this one. Builds shipped before the rename have that hostname compiled in and cannot be told about a new one, so it serves indefinitely. Deploy it only AFTER coil-update-relay is live and populated.
